its ErrorKind name is NOT in remote_rejection_reason's allowlist in sync/quarantine/keys_classifier.rs, so it can never become a persisted quarantine reason code; and reason_code_for only ever sees a CONSTRUCTED error, which this never is

the door it documents is unbuilt: no dict-asset existence check exists. analyzer/manifest.rs fails the open-time handshake with IncompatibleAnalyzer, and config.rs:330 documents IncompatibleAnalyzer as the escape hatch
dead_verdict.why_keep: deleting it edits ErrorKind, and `ErrorKind byte-identical` is the single invariant that makes this refactor mechanically verifiable (check c). It costs nothing to carry: it moves with StoreError like any other variant, with zero call sites to rewrite. Delete it in its own one-line PR, before or after, never inside this one.
